exact_packing.off_diagonal: Keep every cross-block Gram entry. RC self blocks use seven length(2K-1) anti-diagonal arrays per mode: H0,Hnm for each forced/free self block and H0,Hn,Hnm for their cross block. Reconstruct first moments of symmetric blocks as s*H0/2 and cross Hm=s*H0-Hn.
exact_packing.OCV: 25 source charge Chebyshev moments reconstruct its13x13 self Gram; retain all OCV cross blocks.
exact_packing.purpose: Exact cost, original-coordinate gradient and Gauss-Newton on the represented feature manifold in mathematical arithmetic. Raw moments retain possible numerical cancellation; no clipping.

rank_storage.scaling: Fixed positive feature envelopes: full public amplitude support; |Chebyshev|<=1 in declared nonlinear domain; RC amplitudes times rho^n; OCV |inverse| row sums times4.23V/sigma. No fitted center, truth, query-dependent rank or singular-value threshold.
rank_storage.batch: SVD of scaled full QR, retain exactly r rows. delta=sigma_(r+1)^2 bounds the discarded PSD Gram in scaled coordinates. Diagnostic oracle only.
rank_storage.stream: Append one scaled source row to r-row factor, truncate to fixed r by SVD. Accumulate discarded largest singular value squared in delta. This carries a PSD remainder bound instead of treating truncated information as zero.
rank_storage.query: psi=phi/envelope; cost interval [||Bpsi||^2/2, ||Bpsi||^2/2+delta||psi||^2/2]. Gradient component remainder<=delta||psi||||Jpsi_j||; GN remainder PSD bounded by delta*Jpsi^T Jpsi. Exact-arithmetic certificates only; finite floating-point controls separate.
rank_storage.merge: Globally aligned adjacent source blocks only; concatenate retained rows, truncate, add inherited deltas and new discarded spectral bound. Reject overlap, gap, domain/config mismatch. No independent physical entry-domain transport claim.

checks.numerics: Inherited abs2e-8+rel2e-10 for direct/reference arithmetic; record finite mismatches without aborting. Nonfinite/source/domain violations hard stop. No tolerance adaptation.
checks.exact_packing: Cost and gradient at all points; GN at mean; compare direct rows and full QR. Demonstrate cost-only anti-diagonal compression loses GN with a fixed PSD 3x3 counterexample.
checks.bounds: All query cost/gradient envelopes; GN spectral upper and lower bound at mean; global scaled Gram residual eigenvalue check with allowance 128eps*max(1,||A||F^2). No inference from this tolerance to physical accuracy.
checks.merge: Rank8 split17/rest for each source case; compare represented-reference gaps against merged envelope; reject duplicate source and nonadjacent merge. No equality required after lossy merge.
checks.cancellation: 4096 local K9: replace observed-voltage column to zero represented residual at public mean; compare exact packed, QR and rank8 interval, no clipping.
checks.provenance: Reproduce predecessor represented costs versus saved reference; source hashes before/after. Original artifacts unchanged.

memory: Full inherited boundary,metadata,nonbank and query-work reservations retained. Packed ledger replaces only full QR numeric payload. Rank retained payload=8*r*F+8delta; fixed envelopes may be ROM. Add explicit append/SVD matrix and factor output/small U/S storage lower bounds; LAPACK workspace and target code not qualified. decision: Compare exact algebraic savings, cancellation, added likelihood distortion and explicit uncertainty widths against complete SRAM. Do not choose ranks by a new physical threshold. No solver, aging, prior or physical model change; no long-trajectory claim.
